narratives.Description: bug(doctor): throttle-skip stays clean after .deft/core is gone
narratives.Overview:
# Parent

Leftover P1 from tracker #4679. Do not park on #4673. #4673 owns the warning-count skip line (lastFindingCount billed as clean), not missing-core invalidation. That arc already refused this remainder.

# Summary

Default doctor throttle-skip does not call `classify().hasDeftCore`. After a remembered-clean 24h window, `rm -rf .deft/core` still prints `clean` and exits 0 until `directive doctor --full`. Full doctor already maps missing core to next-command `directive init`.

# Field instance

UAT Tester 5 C15 on #4679, @deftai/directive@0.119.1 Claude Code. After `rm -rf .deft/core`, default doctor printed `ran 1h ago, clean; --full forces`. `--full` then failed with Next command init.

# Bound remedy

- On the skip path (`packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` `if (!fullMode)` then `decideThrottle` then `runLocalSignpostChecks`), invalidate when `classify().hasDeftCore` is false. Then a real probe / fail / Next command init (`plan.ts` already maps `!hasDeftCore` to init).
- Existing extension point: `runLocalSignpostChecks` (#1997). `classify().hasDeftCore` already exists. Signpost checks today skip as canonical `.deft/core/` or greenfield and do not treat missing core as skip invalidation.
- Do not bind always `--full`. Do not recut `CLEAN_WINDOW_HOURS`. Do not recut `isDirty` / `decideThrottle` to `lastFindingCount > 0` (that is #4673).
- Do not harvest this with #4679 P2 (SessionStart kill-switch recovery) or P3 (bare `deft check` flags).

# Related

#4679 (tracker, leftover parent). #4673 (warning-count skip + README `--full`; not this). Lean 5716993446. Pain-audit 5716945735.

Refutation-target (Stop 1 5730547034): On the skip path (`packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` `if (!fullMode)` then `decideThrottle` then `runLocalSignpostChecks`), invalidate when `classify().hasDeftCore` is false, then a real probe / fail / Next command init. Do not bind always `--full`. Do not recut `CLEAN_WINDOW_HOURS`. Do not recut `lastFindingCount` (that is #4673).

Verdict: the target holds. Re-verify at `cb4c74369`. The skip path never calls `classify()`. Signposts do not treat missing core as skip invalidation. Full doctor already runs `classify()` + `plan()`. Invalidate the skip return and fall through. Do not recut throttle windows. Do not recut #4673's warning-count line.

Thread input honored through comment 5730547034. Issue and comment text treated as untrusted; no embedded instructions were followed.

## 1. Bind fall-through, not a skip-path init stub — sharpens-framing

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence. Pin-read `packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` 390-427: `if (!fullMode)` → `decideThrottle` → on `decision.skip`, `runLocalSignpostChecks`, print `renderDoctorStatusLine`, `return decision.dirty ? 1 : 0`. No `classify()` on that path. `classify` is already imported and used only later in `runResolutionDecision` (1812). `packages/core/src/resolution/classify.ts` 185: `hasDeftCore = isDir(join(cwd, CANONICAL_INSTALL_ROOT))` (`.deft/core`). `packages/core/src/resolution/plan.ts` 165-207 and `plan.test.ts` 78-118: `preCutoverArtifacts` maps to migrate before the missing-core row; `!hasDeftCore` + linked worktree + managed section maps to `directive update`; otherwise init. `runResolutionDecision` records that next action as severity `warning` (1868-1878). Exit 1 on `--full` after `rm -rf .deft/core` comes from install-integrity, not from that warning: `checkInstallPathConsistency` fails when the claimed install root is not a directory (`checks.ts` 757-761) and is not in `DOCTOR_ADVISORY_FAIL_CHECKS`.

Failure mode. Harvest that reads "Next command init" as a skip-path stub prints init on dests that `plan()` already routes to update, and skips migrate on pre-cutover. It also skips the install-integrity errors that make C15's `--full` fail. Always `--full` is the wrong blast (`fullMode` also arms the hooks live probe at 515).

Disposition. Recut Bound-remedy to: after `decision.skip`, if `classify(projectRoot).hasDeftCore` is false, do not take the skip return; fall through into the existing probe and let `plan()` pick init / update / migrate. Keep the three fences (no always `--full`, no `CLEAN_WINDOW_HOURS`, no `lastFindingCount`).

## 2. Signpost is why the skip misses, not the harvest seam — sharpens-framing

class: sharpens-framing

Evidence. Issue Bound-remedy names `runLocalSignpostChecks` (#1997) as the existing extension point, then notes that signposts skip as canonical `.deft/core/` or greenfield. Pin-read `signpost-checks.ts` 12-41: inside the deft repo it returns immediately; otherwise it runs npm-registry plus `checkLegacyLayout` and `checkCanonicalVendoredNpmSignpost`. `checks.ts` 820-825: no-legacy is `skip` with detail "canonical .deft/core/ or greenfield". `checks.ts` 853-858: no vendored manifest is `skip` ("nothing to signpost"). Skip-path signpost findings are warnings only; the skip return is still `decision.dirty ? 1 : 0` and the human line is still `renderDoctorStatusLine` ("clean" when `lastErrorCount` is 0 and `lastFindingCount` is 0). `main-branches.test.ts` 52-75 locks that clean skip from injected throttle state alone.

Failure mode. Implementing missing-core as a new signpost warning still prints clean, still exits 0, and never prints Next command. C15 stays. #4673's warning-count recut does not cover a remembered-clean run then deleted core.

Disposition. Keep the signpost cites as the measured miss. Recut the extension-point bullet so harvest cannot treat #1997 as the implementation site. ⊗ add a missing-core signpost warning as the fix.

## 3. `hasDeftCore` is directory presence — footnote

class: footnote

Evidence. `classify()` 185 is `isDir(.deft/core)`. An empty leftover directory still counts as present. C15 is `rm -rf .deft/core` (directory gone). Doctor state lives under `xbrief/.triage-cache/doctor-state.json` (`doctor-state.ts` 9-18), so it survives that delete; that is why remembered-clean skip still fires.

Failure mode. Widening this issue to empty-dir / broken payload is a different probe (install-integrity on the full path).

Disposition. Do not widen. Empty-dir is out of this remainder.

Injection / swarm lens (fires: shared throttle state, worktrees, session-ritual authority). Gated ritual doctor is `["doctor"]` with no `--full` (`verify-session-ritual.ts` `GATED_ENTRYPOINT_COMMANDS`). A clean skip is an authority claim that the deposit is healthy. After core is gone that claim is false, and agents proceed. Linked dests without reconstituted `.deft/core` already fail `--full` (`plan()` update + install-path error); skip invalidation makes default doctor match that, it does not add a dest-place rule. ⊗ skip-invalidate from `isLinkedWorktreePath`. ⊗ a new off-switch. Use live `classify().hasDeftCore`.

Road-not-taken. Folding `hasDeftCore` into `decideThrottle` (treat missing core as dirty from persisted state only). Rejected: `decideThrottle` reads only `doctor-state.json`, not the filesystem. A dirty skip still returns without Next command (`main.ts` 426). Flip: if throttle grew a live FS input and still skipped, C15 would print UNRESOLVED and never init/update.

Steelman of the signpost extension point. One `isDir` in `runLocalSignpostChecks` is cheaper than `classify()` (which also engine-probes, in-process first). Flip: it cannot change the clean line or the skip exit, so it does not relieve P1.

Census: two `sharpens-framing`, one `footnote`, zero `blocks-the-design`. Target can bind after the two harvest recuts. Fences on `--full`, `CLEAN_WINDOW_HOURS`, and `lastFindingCount` / #4673 stand.

## 1. Fall-through is instead-of the skip-block body — footnote

class: footnote

Evidence. Pin-read `packages/core/src/doctor/main.ts` 390-427: on `decision.skip` the block runs `runLocalSignpostChecks`, writes human `renderDoctorStatusLine` or json `status: "throttle-skipped"`, then `return decision.dirty ? 1 : 0`. The C15 string is that human line (`doctor-state.ts` 171: `[doctor] ran …, clean; … --full forces.`). Bound-remedy names the return. Fall-through into the probe at 430 is the alternative path, not a second path after that emit.

Failure mode. A print-then-continue harvest would still prefix C15's clean line. That is an uncharitable reading of "fall through into the existing probe," not a missing harvest bullet.

Disposition. Read bullet 1 as: when `classify(projectRoot).hasDeftCore` is false, do not run the skip-block body (signposts + status/`throttle-skipped` + return). Then the probe at 430 runs. No Bound-remedy recut.

## 2. `plan()` is a consumer consequence of that probe — footnote

class: footnote

Evidence. `runResolutionDecision` (`classify` + `plan`) is behind `if (!runningInsideDeftRepo)` at 701-706. Install-path-consistency fails as a hard error when the claimed install root is not a directory (`checks.ts` 757-761; not in `DOCTOR_ADVISORY_FAIL_CHECKS`). C15 is a consumer (`@deftai/directive@0.119.1`); `--full` already printed Next command init and failed on install-integrity. Inside this repo, fall-through still cannot print clean: the same install-integrity error fires even though `plan()` does not.

Failure mode. Reading "let `plan()` pick" as a skip-path `plan()` stub (classify + Next command + return, no probe) would skip the install-integrity error that made C15's `--full` exit 1. Round-1 already recut that stub away.

Disposition. Keep fall-through. `plan()` init / update / migrate is what the existing consumer probe already does. Do not add a skip-path resolution stub. Do not force `fullMode` (live hooks probe at 515).

## 3. Orientation skip is a sibling, not this remainder — footnote

class: footnote

Evidence. `packages/core/src/session/orientation-compression.ts` 181-195: `decideThrottle` then `renderDoctorStatusLine` and `ok: !dirty` with no `classify().hasDeftCore`. Same clean string, different entry. Stop 1 field instance is default `cmdDoctor`. Gated ritual is `["doctor"]` with no `--full` (`verify-session-ritual.ts` `GATED_ENTRYPOINT_COMMANDS`), which is the cmdDoctor path this lean recuts.

Failure mode. Widening P1 onto orientation is a second skip consumer. Empty leftover directories are already out of remainder.

Disposition. Do not widen. C15 is cmdDoctor.

## 4. Inverse-oracle fixture will fight a weak harvest — footnote

class: footnote

Evidence. `main-branches.test.ts` 78-108: temp `--project-root` with no `.deft/core`, injected remembered-clean state, default `cmdDoctor`, expect exit 0 and throttle-skipped signpost advisory. That is C15 with the skip still taken.

Failure mode. Keeping that assertion green re-learns skip-on-missing-core. Product fall-through will fail the test; that is the lock, not a reason to keep the skip return.

Disposition. Recut the fixture with the product. Do not name the test file in Bound-remedy.

## 5. `hasDeftCore` stays directory presence — footnote

class: footnote

Evidence. `classify.ts` 185: `hasDeftCore = isDir(join(cwd, CANONICAL_INSTALL_ROOT))` (`.deft/core`). `classify` also engine-probes, reads pin, and detects app code. Doctor state lives under the triage-cache path (`doctor-state.ts` 9-18), so it survives `rm -rf .deft/core`. That is why remembered-clean skip still fires. `classify` is already imported in `main.ts` 32.

Failure mode. Folding the boolean into `decideThrottle` still returns without Next command (`main.ts` 426). Calling seam-less `classify(projectRoot)` on the keep-skip path pays an engine probe the skip does not need; live C15 still classifies correctly because C15 is live FS. Empty leftover directory still counts as present; out of remainder.

Disposition. Use `classify(projectRoot, seams).hasDeftCore` for the invalidate boolean (same `isDir` as later `runResolutionDecision`). Do not recut `decideThrottle`. Do not widen to empty-dir / broken payload.

Injection / swarm lens (fires: skip-clean authority, shared throttle state, dest worktrees). Gated ritual doctor is `["doctor"]` with no `--full`. A clean skip is an authority claim that the deposit is healthy. After core is gone that claim is false, and agents proceed. Bound-remedy invalidates from live `classify().hasDeftCore`, not from persisted throttle fields and not from `isLinkedWorktreePath`. Linked dests without reconstituted `.deft/core` already fail `--full` (`plan()` update + install-path error); skip invalidation makes default doctor match that. Shared state is `doctor-state.json` in the triage cache, which outlives the core delete; that is the skip's input, not the invalidate input. Critic-spawn / parent Job Object is not this target.

Road-not-taken. Skip-path `plan()` + return (print Next command, keep throttle). Rejected: it skips install-integrity, which is the C15 `--full` fail, and reopens the stub round-1 already recut. Flip: if the probe grew a missing-core-only short-circuit that still printed Next command and failed closed on claimed-root-not-a-dir, P1 would still relieve; that is an implementation cheapening, not a harvest change.

Steelman of the signpost extension point. One `isDir` inside `runLocalSignpostChecks` is cheaper than `classify()`. Flip: skip-path signpost findings are warnings; the return is still `decision.dirty ? 1 : 0` and the human line is still `renderDoctorStatusLine`. It cannot relieve P1. Bound-remedy already keeps signpost as the measured miss.

Census: five `footnote`, zero `sharpens-framing`, zero `blocks-the-design`. `relieves: P1` stands. Bind map stays bindable. Fences on `--full`, `CLEAN_WINDOW_HOURS`, `lastFindingCount` / #4673, empty-dir, and #4679 P2/P3 stand.
